tool_args.rationale: The gradient probe reveals a pronounced negative high-gradient branch, while the low-gradient observations are consistent with a sink-modulated saturating base. Fit the avalanche onset and exponent numerically rather than assuming its shape, then use fresh confirmation to test generalization.

considered_alternatives.option: Previously confirmed hydraulic saturation with threshold avalanche
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Its fresh confirmation RMSE was 0.720654, above tolerance; the prior branch specification is not established by the supplied history.

considered_alternatives.option: Siphon base with a fitted power-law threshold branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Selected for a new confirmation; the high-gradient observations support a nonlinear loss but do not uniquely establish its shape.

considered_alternatives.option: Extra fine trajectory and high-gradient probes
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Both have already been acquired; the available observations justify testing a revised branch before further measurement.
One failed stationary model does not refute all stationary mechanisms, and no chaotic sign-oscillation signature was reported.
